about: A grey ("white") horse: white hair over dark skin.
ref: lowpoly-animals/references/muzzles.md; eyes.md; lowpoly-core/references/measuring.md, Turning the request into search subjects

palette.coat: white to pale silver grey, warm in the lights, cool grey in the shadows
palette.skin where the hair is thin: charcoal: the nose, nostrils, lips and chin, a ring round each eye, the dock

rules: The skin shows where the hair is thinnest: the nose, lips and chin go to charcoal (a photo: lips 0.11 against a face of 0.33); the top of the muzzle may stay pale and lit.
Freckles of dark specks are allowed on the face; no outline anywhere.
